provenance.sourceName: SBP C14/C15 exact-model evidence plus Carrier and Daikin official source review
provenance.matchingRule: Exact brand and type plus exact indoor code, or exact indoor/outdoor pair in either order. Field requires manufacturer-reviewed status, exactModel=true, a SHA-256 retained for the primary source, an HTTPS manufacturer source, and an October 2026 check date.
provenance.excluded: Retailer prices, company prices, stock, installation hints, warranty terms and HTTP-only source links were not imported. The two Carrier power-consumption kW values are converted to W; refrigerant charge g is converted to kg Daikin manual capacities remain in kW and kcal/h; no BTU conversion was inferred.
